The original sun, crescent and star emblem celebrates light, possibility and connection.

Black American Heritage Flag: designed by Melvin Charles and Gleason T. Jackson (1967). SVG rendition by Xophe84, Wikimedia Commons (CC0), resized for this app. Globe geography: Natural Earth, public domain, via world-atlas.

Data: Frankfurter and its official-source providers. Cryptocurrency reference values: Swiss Federal Tax Administration (ESTV). These are dated reference conversions, not executable trading quotes.

Metals: troy ounces. Crypto: units of each coin. National and shared currencies use their currency codes; flags identify currencies and are not a statement about sovereignty.

Only fetched rate snapshots are cached on this device. Fresh snapshots may be reused for six hours. If a request fails, a saved rate may be shown for up to seven days, clearly labeled. Amounts and conversion history are not saved. No ads or analytics SDKs are included.
